name: arc-harness-kit
description: Build kit that turns your copy of the original app archive, version 0.2.1-rc.5, into Arc Harness

scripts.test: node scripts/check-syntax.mjs && node lib/arcnames.mjs && node test/iconcolor.test.mjs && node --test plugins/arc-hoh/test/hoh.test.mjs plugins/arc-theme/test/theme.test.mjs test/lean-profile.test.mjs && node scripts/privacy-scan.mjs --self-test
scripts.test:archive: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('build/check',{recursive:true})" && node test/build-check.mjs build/app.asar build/check && node test/ui-strings.mjs && node test/independent-scan.mjs && node test/positive-control.mjs
